title: no Wear Collection Service with miaomiao2
symptom: When using the smartwatch as standalone with miaomiao2, no data are read. The smartwatch sees mm2 as Limitter. This occurs with recent nightly versions of xDrip.
cause: The thread suggests that newer versions of xDrip do not have access to Wear API, which prevents the watch from acting as a data collector when standalone.
fix: A user provided a link to a version of xDrip+ that is 'totally functional with MM2 in smartwatches' and advised to pair the watch to the MM2.
evidence_quote: It seems your vesion from 13/04/2019 works fine! And the new versions don't have access to Wear API.
